audit.whatIsWrong: Three ability errors. (1) The page says that while his spirit is out 'he's untargetable on his body' — Riot's text says nothing of the kind. (2) Fate Sealed is repeatedly called a 'recall-dash' with a 'knock-up' — it is a blink behind the last champion in a line that PULLS enemies toward him, with no knockup. (3) Spirit Cleave's shield is never mentioned anywhere despite being the thing that eats Irelia's burst.
audit.why: Riot text — E Soul Unbound: 'Yone's spirit leaves his body behind, gaining Move Speed. When this ability ends, Yone's spirit is forced back to his body and he repeats a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit' (22/19/16/13/10s). R Fate Sealed: 'blinks behind the last champion in a line with a slash so powerful it pulls all enemies hit towards him' (120/100/80s). W Spirit Cleave: 'Grants a shield to Yone, the value is increased by the number of champions hit', 14s scaling with attack speed. Only Q at 2 stacks knocks Airborne.
audit.corrected: Spirit returns to the body it left behind — hold E for the snap-back. R is a blink-and-pull, not a knockup escape. Spirit Cleave shields every 14s and must be forced out before committing burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Yone levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items and marked 4-5 and 6 as Skill — the opposite of the packet chart, of every whys line, and of a 55.58% Irelia win rate over 1605 games.
audit.why: Defiant Dance flips level 2, Flawless Duet flips 3, Ionian Fervor ramp owns 4-5, Vanguard's Edge on the Soul Unbound return point owns 6, first item is her peak. Only 2+ crit items belong to Yone.
audit.corrected: Skill, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Irelia, Yone — matched pairs both layers with ratings.

audit.why: Spike order is right: Irelia at 3, 6 and first item; Yone at two crit items. Phase text now carries the Soul Unbound cooldown range so the level-6 spike is actionable.

edits.before: Q resets through minions are your engine — keep the wave healthy. Only take the trade when Yone's Soul Unbound is down.
edits.after: Defiant Dance's damage reduction eats his cleave poke and Q3 knock-up, so level 2 flips the short trades to your side.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Soul Unbound's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your window: Ionian Fervor stacks shred his thin resists, so every extended E-stun trade ramps harder than his cleave poke.

edits.before: Vanguard’s Edge walls off his disengage and marks the kill. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yone's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Soul Unbound forces his spirit back to the body he left — wall that spot with Vanguard's Edge, stun the return, all-in.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Soul Unbound's cooldown.
edits.after: First item is your peak — force every fight before his second crit item, on Soul Unbound's 10-22s cooldown.

edits.before: He snaps back when it ends. Stun him there. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His spirit is forced back to the body — stand on that point and stun the return.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields him every 14s — force it out before you burst.

edits.before: Flawless Duet is a hard stun his Q dash and R recall-dash can't break — bait him in, stun him between the blades, then Q-reset and he can't answer.
edits.after: Flawless Duet is a hard stun neither his Q dash nor Fate Sealed's blink can break — bait him in, stun him between the blades, then Q-reset him down.

edits.before: He out-scales hard: a two-crit-item Yone kites with Q3 knock-up, W cleave and R recall-dash as a slippery carry — play safe and end the game before then.
edits.after: He out-scales hard: a two-crit-item Yone kites with the Q3 knock-up, Spirit Cleave's shield and Fate Sealed's blink-and-pull — end it before that.

edits.before: Punish his E (Soul Unbound): the moment his spirit leaves his body it WILL snap back to that fixed spot — E-stun him on the return point and Vanguard's Edge-wall it so he can't reposition the recall, then all-in.
edits.after: Punish his E (Soul Unbound), down 22s at rank 1 and 10s at rank 5: his spirit is always forced back to the body he left behind — hold that spot, wall it with Vanguard's Edge, E-stun him on the return, then commit.

edits.before: Hit 6 and use the R recall-and-dash knock-up to all-in your reset or disengage a losing trade
edits.after: Hit 6 and use Fate Sealed to blink behind you and pull you back in to break your reset chain

edits.before: Level 1 is a soft window for you both — he chips with Q and W spirit-cleave but you just farm with Q (Bladesurge) off the wave and don't step in for a trade you can't finish without your stun. At level 2 your W (Defiant Dance) lets you channel through his Q3 knock-up and eat his cleave poke at reduced damage. Level 3 is where you take over: Flawless Duet is a hard stun his Q dash and R cannot break, so bait him in, drop the two blades, stun him between them, then Q the marked target for a reset combo. Respect his E (Soul Unbound) — while his spirit is out he's untargetable on his body, so don't waste your E on the spirit; punish the moment it snaps back.
edits.after: Level 1 is a soft window for you both — he chips with Q and W spirit-cleave but you just farm with Q (Bladesurge) off the wave and don't step in for a trade you can't finish without your stun. At level 2 your W (Defiant Dance) lets you channel through his Q3 knock-up and eat his cleave poke at reduced damage. Level 3 is where you take over: Flawless Duet is a hard stun his Q dash and R cannot break, so bait him in, drop the two blades, stun him between them, then Q the marked target for a reset combo. Respect his E (Soul Unbound) — his spirit roams while his body stays put, and it is forced back there, so hold your E for the snap-back instead of chasing.

notes: Removed a fabricated mechanic: the page claimed Yone is untargetable on his body during Soul Unbound. Riot's text says only that the spirit leaves the body behind and is forced back to it — no untargetability, so the claim is gone rather than reversed. Fate Sealed was described as a 'recall-dash knock-up'; it is a blink behind the last champion in a line that pulls enemies toward him. Spirit Cleave's shield added. packet.defects flagged 'Vanguard's Edge-wall' — false positive on the hyphenated verb form, but the sentence was rewritten anyway.
